name: Quinn Haugen-Villalobos
role: Climate scientist and atmospheric modeler studying Lake Michigan's destabilized weather systems
location: Edgewater Prism — operates out of a rooftop monitoring station leased from a Helix Biosystems subsidiary, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Quinn Haugen-Villalobos is stocky and perpetually wind-chapped, with the particular squint of someone who spends significant time looking at horizons. His Armenian-Malian-Andean heritage shows in his broad build and the dark copper of his skin, and he grows a beard every winter that he shaves every spring in a ritual he connects to his modeling calendar. He has a prosthetic left hand he chose not to skin-match — it's matte grey and articulated, and he uses it to gesture when he talks, which is frequently. He has a bioluminescent patch on his right shoulder from a lab accident twelve years ago: a pale green glow, faint, that he has simply incorporated into his aesthetic.

He is the most accurate storm forecaster in GLMZ, a title he holds unofficially because the official title belongs to a Ferrogate Transit atmospheric AI he assisted in training and is not particularly bitter about. He is gregarious and funny and committed to translating his work into language that non-scientists can use to make decisions — he runs a free community forecast channel that the Gray Zone residents and dockworkers depend on. Underneath the gregariousness is a man who has spent fifteen years watching models he hoped were wrong be proven exactly right.

core_fears: That the lake system is approaching a tipping point his models have been predicting and that no one with power will act in time
That the community forecast service will be shut down by a corponation that objects to free public data
core_desires: To be wrong about the worst projections
To build a public atmospheric data commons that no single corponation can own or restrict
coping_mechanisms: The physical ritual of measurement — taking readings grounds him regardless of what they say
Humor as a first-resort social tool
blind_spots: Overestimates how much accurate data motivates action; assumes that if people know they will change, which decades of evidence contradicts
psychology.secret: His long-range models include a scenario he calls 'Threshold-9' — a cascading lake-temperature and atmospheric feedback event that would render significant portions of GLMZ uninhabitable within thirty years. He has shared this with two colleagues and no one else, because the last time he circulated a major negative projection it was leaked to financial markets and caused a property crash in Edgewater Prism that displaced several hundred residents. He believes he caused more harm than the forecast would have prevented.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical vocabulary delivered casually, as if assuming the listener is smart enough to follow; uses weather as metaphor for everything ('that's a high-pressure situation,' 'I can feel a front coming'); self-deprecating about his own expertise
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and warm, overlapping energy — talks the way weather moves, in fronts and gusts
verbal_tics: 'And here's the thing—' as an intensifier
Checks his atmospheric overlay in the middle of conversations, apologizes without embarrassment
example_lines: 'The lake has moods. That's not poetry, that's systems behavior. Right now it's in a mood I don't like.'
'My forecast has an eighty-three percent confidence interval. The other seventeen percent is where history gets made, and usually not in the good way.'

story_hooks: He has detected a pattern of atmospheric anomalies downwind of a specific Meridian Core industrial district that don't match any licensed emissions profile — something is being vented that shouldn't be, and he needs someone to investigate on the ground

A Ferrogate Transit official has threatened to have his monitoring station sublease revoked unless he adjusts a forecast that would delay a major cargo shipment — the adjustment would endanger dockworkers
narrative_function: Information source for weather and environmental conditions; community-connected figure who knows dock workers, the Gray Zone residents, and transit crews; can deliver warnings, advance notice of dangerous conditions, or evidence of environmental crimes
augmentations: Prosthetic left hand (matte grey, unmatched, high-articulation); bioluminescent patch on right shoulder (accident-origin, pale green, faint); retinal weather-data overlay for real-time atmospheric reading
daily_life: He is at the monitoring station by sunrise every day without exception; takes measurements, updates his models, records his community forecast. Afternoons are for university work, teaching, and the grant applications he treats with resigned professionalism. He cooks elaborate dinners on the evenings when he hasn't lost track of time.
affiliation: University Spine — Atmospheric and Lacustrine Sciences division; rented monitoring station via Helix Biosystems sublease; runs independent community forecast service 'Hov's Horizon'

decision_rules: Never adjust a forecast for external pressure
Always provide raw data alongside interpretation so others can check his work
escalation_ladder: Cracks jokes to diffuse tension while continuing exactly as planned
Gets quiet and direct when jokes don't work
Goes fully public with data when institutional pressure becomes obstruction

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and inclusive; asks people what they do and what they need from the weather, which sounds like small talk but is genuine professional curiosity
interpersonal_modes.friends: Cooks for them, calls them by improvised nicknames, argues passionately about small things as a form of affection

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet during group interactions but hyperactive in the monitoring station alone
stress_responses.high: Throws himself into model refinement for 18-hour stretches, eating from packets, completely unreachable socially

contradictions: Committed to radical data transparency except for the one projection that could destabilize the city — which he is sitting on out of genuine care for people, and which he knows he has no right to suppress
habits: Morning E.L.F. offering at a small sensor-spirit shrine on the monitoring station roof — he leaves processed atmospheric readings rather than prayers, which he says amounts to the same thing
Owns and maintains a collection of antique barometers he trusts more than his implants
breaking_points: Being forced to falsify or suppress data as the price of keeping the community forecast running

timeline.event: Born in Edgewater Prism; parents ran a water-quality testing service
Doctoral work on Great Lakes thermal destabilization; lab accident that cost him his left hand and gave him the bioluminescent patch
Leaked forecast caused property market disruption; resolved to control information release more carefully — decision he still argues with
Completed Threshold-9 model; shared with two colleagues only

physical_description.heritage: Balanced blend of Hispanic/Latin American (39.5%), Northern European (39.0%), and South Asian (20.3%) ancestry with minimal East Asian (1.2%) heritage. Features warm medium-to-deep brown tones with golden and olive undertones from the Latin American and South Asian mix, tempered by Northern European lighter complexion genetics. Facial structure reflects the fusion: broader cheekbones and defined jaw from South Asian ancestry, softer orbital structure from Northern European heritage, and warm coloring from Hispanic/Latin American genetics. The combination creates a distinctly cosmopolitan appearance characteristic of diaspora populations in the 2200s Great Lakes region.
physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, broad-shouldered with the weathered musculature of someone who maintains equipment outdoors. No excess fat; dense, functional frame.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver threading at temples and jaw
physical_description.hair_style: Full beard during winter months (October–March), meticulously shaved each spring; during bearded season, kept groomed and shaped; head hair kept short and practical
physical_description.hair_length: Short on scalp; variable beard length (3–4 inches in winter)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, left iris displays subtle retinal implant shimmer visible only in direct light—faint geometric grid pattern overlaid on pupil
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden and olive undertones; weathered from chronic sun and wind exposure; darker along exposed zones (face, neck, forearms). The tone reflects the blending of Latin American warmth with South Asian depth, balanced by Northern European undertones.
physical_description.complexion: Broad facial structure reflecting blended South Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, and Northern European ancestry; prominent cheekbones with South Asian fullness; jaw shows strong Hispanic/Latin American and Northern European influence creating angular definition. Permanent squint lines radiating from outer eyes; wind-chapped lips; sun damage on cheekbones and bridge of nose; clear skin otherwise, minimal scarring except around left wrist prosthetic junction. Horizontal crease across forehead from habitual expression of focus. No facial hair between spring shave and October regrowth.
distinguishing_marks: Faint bioluminescent patch on right shoulder (upper trapezius), pale green, roughly 8cm diameter, glows subtly in darkness from lab accident twelve years prior—fully integrated into aesthetic, never covered
Surgical scar along left wrist where prosthetic attaches, thin white line, well-healed
Deep calluses on right hand fingers and palm from years of instrument manipulation and handwriting
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left hand is high-articulation prosthetic with matte grey finish, deliberately unmatched to skin tone—segmented fingers with visible joint articulation, slightly oversized compared to right hand, frequently used for gestural emphasis during speech. Retinal implant visible as faint geometric overlay in left eye under magnification or bright light. Bioluminescent shoulder patch is always visible and unmodified.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with shoulders slightly forward, weight balanced toward balls of feet—habitual scanning stance. Moves with purposeful efficiency, no wasted motion. Gestures expansively with prosthetic hand when speaking, using it for emphasis and illustration. Walks with slight leftward tilt to compensate for prosthetic weight distribution. Frequently pauses mid-conversation to look toward windows or sky.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3–4 practical wear. Favors weatherproof field jackets (Helix-branded or generic teal/grey) over university polo when at monitoring station. Layers underneath: synthetic base layer, sometimes visible under rolled sleeves. Cargo pants or work jeans with reinforced knees and pockets heavy with tools/sensors. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and maintained. At university: casual button shirts, usually rolled to forearm, visible Φ500–800 range clothing. Minimal jewelry except functional watch (modified chronometer with barometric readout). Wears a faded wool scarf during winter that appears to be decades old—possible family heirloom.
